shots.title: Split SLOPE's roadmap into project, archived-history, and live-phase source documents

hazards.description: The monolith contained nine sprint definitions with no phase membership. Federation repaired those memberships explicitly instead of encoding invalid structure into the source bundle.

shots.notes: The repository now has one manifest, 37 fully evidenced archive bundles, six live or unevidenced phase bundles, and exactly one membership for every sprint.

shots.title: Compile and validate the compatibility JSON without semantic drift

hazards.description: The first migration silently normalized historical complexity and GitHub issue shapes. Independent review required exact S1-S231 definition fidelity, bounded legacy compatibility, a baseline digest, and deep-clone isolation.

shots.notes: Historical sprint definitions now match pre-federation commit 2fd935d byte-for-byte; only the nine membership repairs change the projection.

shots.title: Route contributor and agent guidance through roadmap focus and source validation

hazards.description: The first guidance pass requested a sprint number before discovery and missed contradictory roadmap docs plus tracked and shipped sprint skill surfaces. Two review rounds were needed to propagate discovery, focus, and briefing consistently.

shots.notes: Repository docs, generated templates, local Claude workflows, Codex plugin skills, and Pi/Claude start commands now use discovery to bounded focus to briefing.

shots.title: Record dogfood hazards and end-to-end validation
shots.notes: S231-to-S232 used the audited rollover transaction, focus stayed bounded on the accumulated repository, source validation and projection checks passed, and both independent review lanes approved.

conditions.description: Migrating 131 accumulated sprint definitions exposed compatibility facts that the new-source fixtures did not contain: legacy enums, multi-issue fields, orphan memberships, contradictory guidance, and mutable nested arrays.

training.description: Dogfood migrations need a pre-migration semantic baseline, not only source-to-current-output equality.
training.outcome: The repository test pins the S1-S231 definition digest and allows only explicit phase-membership repairs.

training.description: Strict schemas must account for bounded history without silently rewriting it.
training.outcome: Legacy complexity aliases and multi-issue arrays are explicitly typed, validated, preserved, and cloned while new generation remains canonical.

training.description: Workflow guidance is an architecture surface.
training.outcome: All tracked and shipped sprint-start instructions now discover state before requesting bounded roadmap context.

nutrition.description: The final focused review matrix passed 69 tests across source federation, focus projection, repository dogfood, and template guidance.
The complete repository suite passed 3,924 tests with 25 skipped after final review hardening and source closeout.
Production build and TypeScript typecheck passed, including packages/pi-extension.
Both independent lanes rejected two rounds, all required fixes were addressed, and both approved the final migration and agent workflow.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: The split was mechanical; proving that history and every workflow surface survived it was the real architecture work.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: Capture the semantic baseline before migrating, then make the new authoring and generated compatibility layers prove equality independently.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: A legacy array field turned a historical compatibility fix into two mutation-boundary bugs.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: Future SLOPE work can load one focused sprint context and edit one owning YAML bundle instead of carrying the entire roadmap.

bunker_locations: Do not normalize historical fields silently during a storage migration.
A source-to-generated equality test cannot detect drift introduced before both artifacts were created.
When a field widens from scalar to array, audit every clone and formatter boundary.
Discover the sprint before emitting a focus command that requires its identity.
Search tracked skills and shipped templates, not only top-level contributor docs, when changing agent workflow.
yardage_book_updates: docs/roadmap/project.yaml is the ordered authoring manifest; docs/backlog/roadmap.json is generated compatibility output.
Archive bundles require scorecard evidence for every member; unevidenced terminal phases remain under docs/roadmap/phases/.
tests/repo-roadmap-sources.test.ts locks source validity, projection currency, exact membership, archive evidence, and historical definition fidelity.
RoadmapTicket preserves bounded pre-schema compatibility values and focus/source compilation deep-clone multi-issue arrays.
course_management_notes: All implementation and review-repair commits are pushed; no PR merge or ship status is implied.
The S231-to-S232 rollover audit and both S232 independent approvals are tracked in docs/retros.
Known roadmap validation warnings are historical ticket-count and numbering-gap advisories, not source federation errors.
